name: Chambertin
rightsHistoryPurpose: Official filiation, dated legal-entity rights and original-reference evidence for Chambertin (#461). None establishes current farming.

namedPlots.coverageNote: The unchanged INAO Chambertin feature includes Clos de Bèze. CHAMBERTIN and CLOS DE BEZE are audited cadastral areas, distinct from producer holdings. No selectable named-area layer is published: the cru name would otherwise match only the smaller CHAMBERTIN area. Small contacts in neighbouring lieux-dits remain unresolved and the whole-cru outline is retained.
